summary: TJGC Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K with an amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, a notice of extraordinary general meeting, and a proxy form. The filing relates to a corporate governance update, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is described. The EGM notice pertains to shareholder approval of the amended charter documents, which is a routine procedural matter. There are no deal terms, premiums, or advisor appointments. The document is filed by the company as a foreign private issuer. No actionable event or transaction is present.
